subject: AtlasPay: request for incident credits + trial extension
messages:
From: Jordan Levy <jordan.levy@atlaspay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, AtlasPay Support <support@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@atlaspay.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden latency spike affecting payments reconciliation — compensation request

Monica,

We saw a 7x latency spike across our batch reconciliation jobs starting ~10:20 PT yesterday and lasting ~35 minutes (we measured time-to-first-token and full-run completion). That window caused retries in our pipeline and a handful of failed settlements — it had real operational impact. Our CS team logged a support case but we need to understand next steps for remediation and whether Redwood provides credits for downtime/regression windows.

Can you confirm the incident window and what goodwill credit or trial extension you can offer while we evaluate remaining risk? We’re on a paid trial (team plan) with usage still ramping.

I’ve attached our timeline snapshot. Happy to jump on a call.

—Jordan
Head of Payments Engineering
AtlasPay

Attachment: incident-timeline-1124.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Levy <jordan.levy@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden latency spike affecting payments reconciliation — compensation request

Jordan — thanks for the details and the timeline PDF. I’m really sorry AtlasPay hit that window; I know retries in settlement pipelines are painful. I’ve looped in Rishi (Sales Director) and Laura (CS) to coordinate next steps.

Quick plan:
- I’ll confirm the exact service-side telemetry and isolate the request cohort.
- Laura will follow up on product impact and any remediation guidance.
- Rishi / RevOps (Hannah) can review credit frames and propose a formal offer.

Goal: have a proposed credit amount and a short trial extension offer by EOD tomorrow. If you’re available for a 30-min call today at 3pm PT we can walk the timeline together.

Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0168
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Levy <jordan.levy@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden latency spike affecting payments reconciliation — compensation request

Jordan — I pulled the per-route traces for your tenant for 10:00–11:00 PT. There was a transient regression tied to a kernel selector misconfiguration on the serving cluster affecting the xfer/fleet pool in us-west-2. Impacted requests saw median latency jump from ~120ms to ~860ms for that 32–36 min window. We’re treating this as an incident on our side.

Immediate customer-facing actions:
- We recommend a short retry-backoff increase in your reconciliation job while we finalize the fix (I can share a one-pager).
- We’ll share a sanitized incident timeline and a RCA summary once Ops finalizes it (ETA 11/26).

I’ll attach the internal timeline snapshot we used to validate impact.

Laura
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal-impact-snapshot.txt (text, 8KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Sudden latency spike affecting payments reconciliation — compensation request

Team — based on the latency delta and affected volume this looks like a clear candidate for a goodwill credit. Proposed parameters:
- Credit amount: 25% of November usage (applied as account credit usable on hosted API)
- Trial extension: 30 days added to current trial window (to let AtlasPay re-run end-to-end tests)
- Conditions: credit applied upon acceptance; no refund cash-out.

Hannah — can you confirm whether 25% maps to our standard incident bands and whether Finance needs a PO/approval flow? If AtlasPay needs calendar-dated invoice adjustments we’ll route to billing.

Rishi
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Sudden latency spike affecting payments reconciliation — compensation request

Rishi — confirmed. 25% is consistent with our incident credit guidelines for short-duration regressions with measurable customer impact. Finance will accept a simple approval from Sales Lead + CS for accounts under $25k MRR. No PO required for AtlasPay (they are under that threshold).

I’m attaching a proposed credit schedule CSV to send to the customer. I also recommend offering a one-time trial extension of 30 days (as Rishi suggested) and a 60-minute post-incident review call with Laura and Monica.

Attachment: proposed-credit-schedule.csv (csv, 2KB)

—Hannah
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Levy <jordan.levy@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden latency spike affecting payments reconciliation — compensation request

Jordan — thanks again for the timeline. We’ve reviewed telemetry and confirmed the regression window (10:18–10:54 PT). To make this right, Redwood will: 

1) Apply a 25% goodwill credit to your November usage (appears as account credit you can apply to future invoices).
2) Add a 30-day trial extension to your account starting today.
3) Schedule a 60-minute post-incident review (I’ll propose times for next week).

Attached is a one-line credit schedule for your review. If that looks acceptable please reply with “I accept” and we’ll process the credit and extension immediately.

Appreciate the patience — we’ll follow up with a short RCA next week.

Warmly,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0168

Attachment: proposed-credit-schedule.csv (csv, 2KB)
